$comment: Challenges are windows over the level. Each has a completion predicate evaluated by ChallengeSystem against gameplay events.

challenges.label: REACH {metres} m
challenges.description: Survive to the end of the section.

challenges.label: DESTROY {count} {target}
challenges.description: Score kills on a specific hostile unit.

challenges.label: NO CIVILIAN CONTACT
challenges.description: Complete the section without hitting a civilian vehicle.

challenges.label: SURVIVE {seconds}s
challenges.description: Stay alive for a fixed time window.
